The main takeaway from our work is that
the cavitation sub-harmonic signal can be explained by periodic shock-emission from the collapsing cavitation cloud.
shock-emission from single cavitation clouds is periodic, and that the frequency of emission is dependent on the intensity and duration of the driving ultrasound.

the subharmonic is not a fundamental phenomenon, but rather an artifact of the shock emission from the collapsing cloud, which occurs at a frequency that is sub-harmonic to that of the driving ultrasound.
